results.title: Maruvasham
results.overview: A night guard's life unravels after stopping an ATM robbery. When the deceased criminal's powerful brother emerges seeking answers, both police and gangsters close in, leaving him fighting for his family's survival.

results.title: Vamp Ink
results.overview: Vamp Ink is a story about a mysterious tattoo artist who turns her clients into eternal masterpieces.

results.title: Sudden Rain
results.overview: During a sudden downpour, a backpacker becomes stranded on an island. When she is offered shelter by a passing rickshaw driver, they share a fleeting yet profound moment of connection, overcoming the language barrier between them.

results.title: AbiZe
results.overview: Ze, a young bachelor who had lost faith in love. Encouraged by a friend, Ze decides to give love another chance and starts a new relationship with Abi, his colleague. As their romance unfolds, Abi captivates Ze, turning him into a hopeless romantic. However, their relationship takes an unexpected turn when they are confronted with a mysterious equation.

results.title: Château Rouge
results.overview: Goutte d'Or district, Paris, Château Rouge metro station, Georges Clemenceau secondary school. Teenagers, burdened with their carelessness and their wounds, have to grow up. They are shaping their personalities, losing their way, searching for themselves. Adults try to guide them despite the violence of the system.

results.title: Room S401
results.overview: Wolfgang slams himself into the sky above Berlin. But his body is not quite as relaxed as he had hoped.

results.title: You Are Here
results.overview: A young man gets sucked into a dreamlike universe where the resident creature keeps him from getting home.

results.title: That Creep from the Bar Last Night
results.original_title: That Creep from the Bar Last Night
results.overview: Alcoholic band manager, Thom, violently spirals in the hours leading up to his daughter's birthday. He scrambles across town in a final ditch effort to win back her trust and that of his ex-wife, however, it soon becomes clear that his past behavior may never allow him to see them again.

results.title: Where’s Our Money?
results.overview: Three guys from a small town, looking for easy money, decide to rob a local bank. Armed with an excavator, they break into the vault and take everything from there. The morning after the raid, the robbers find out that 25 million rubles have been stolen from the bank. This is where the question "Where is our money?" hangs in the air, because in fact the trio took only a million from the bank, which means that either there is a "rat" among their friends, or there are another 24 million in circulation somewhere in the town.

results.title: Enough is Enough
results.overview: A disgraced "kung fu fraud" teams up with rival masters to turn his hometown into a martial arts tourist trap, only to face a hidden truth as the scheme gains unexpected success.

results.title: David Delfín, muestra tu herida
results.overview: A documentary that takes an emotional journey through the life and career of David Delfín, a unique, controversial, and revolutionary artist who was much more than a fashion designer. It portrays a complete and multidisciplinary creator who used couture to express himself and the catwalk as his megaphone. Beginning with the scandalous 2002 Cour des miracles show—known as “the rope show”—the film explores his artistic vision and his intimate world as a son, brother, boyfriend, and friend. Through moving testimonies from those closest to him, it reveals both his brilliance and vulnerability. In a tragic twist of fate, Delfín and his soulmate, model Bimba Bosé, were both diagnosed with cancer at nearly the same time; she died in January 2017, and he followed five months later.

results.title: Cramps! A Period Piece
results.overview: Agnes defies her overbearing family by working at a technicolor salon, but her newfound independence is challenged when her menstrual cramps take on a terrifying, out-of-control life of their own.

results.title: Boy Mom
results.overview: Ms. Bird was a major Hollywood star in her prime. Now a four-time divorcé who hasn’t worked in years, she attempts to claw her way back into the limelight, leveraging her ill son.

results.title: La nuit des mimosas
results.overview: In a house in the countryside, 17-year-old Paula persuades her mother to join her ecological experiment on her grandmother's embroidered tablecloth under the starry night sky. There, grief, divisions, and a fragile longing for connection come to the surface.

results.title: Bankzitters: Friends Forever
results.overview: In 2025, Bankzitters reach an unprecedented high: three sold-out shows in the Ziggo Dome. Feel the energy on stage, the chaos backstage and the friendship that made it all possible. They themselves can hardly comprehend how this happened, but one thing is certain: they are doing something right.

results.title: Felt Up
results.overview: When date night judgements pit a group of friends against each other, everyone is forced to face the shame of lovers past in order to move forward.

results.title: Downriver a tiger
results.overview: Júlia arrived some time ago in Glasgow fleeing from Barcelona; she wanted to start from scratch. Years have passed and she seems stuck: in the mornings she tries to pursue her career as a photographer, at night she cleans dishes in a restaurant. One afternoon, while taking portraits of pedestrians crossing a bridge, one of her eyes begins to fail. As illness begins to spread Júlia will begin a search into the past to the depths of Glasgow and its history. The river will carry her towards a memory: the day she met a mysterious group of men who pulled objects from the depths of the water and among them a strange Indian boy, Shubham, who also came to the city from far away in search of a new life.

results.title: Dalisay
results.overview: Dalisay's healing touch awakens hidden desires in every man she meets. Is her gift a blessing -- or a dangerous curse?

results.title: Finding The Golden Owl
results.original_title: La découverte de la Chouette d'or
results.overview: The official solutions to the treasure hunt "On The Trail Of The Golden Owl" - the second longest treasure hunt ever organized - which has captivated thousands of researchers for over thirty years.

results.title: Stabbed in the Face: The Rise and Fall of the World's Most Violent Band
results.original_title: Stabbed in the Face: The Rise and Fall of the World's Most Violent Band
results.overview: An alternative documentary following the trail of blood and carnage of Philadelphia’s own Deathmatch Rock n’ Roll pioneers, Eat the Turnbuckle, from beer-soaked bars to the largest stage in the world of metal.
